dataset.citation: Sonawani, S.; Patil, K. (2021), Delhi Multi-Site Air-Quality Data Set, V1, Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/bzhzr9b64v.1
dataset.warning: Curated historical dataset (2018-06 to 2019-10); not a live feed. Results are temporal holdout results for these six stations and this period, not evidence of present-day or geographic transfer.

protocol.split: Per-station chronological 80/20 holdout; candidate selection averages three expanding-window validation folds, each with 48-hour label purges; separate calibration block; 48-hour purge before test boundary.
protocol.features: Issue-time observations and trailing history only.
protocol.targets: Mean PM2.5 at t+1..t+24h and t+25..t+48h; complete hourly windows required.
protocol.metrics: MAE, RMSE, and prediction-minus-observation bias on identical valid test issue times; 90% split-conformal intervals include calibration and test coverage/width.
